course.adab.title: Kwas na Ladabi da Kyawawan Halaye
course.adab.subtitle: Ladabi da kyawawan halaye daga Suratul Fatiha, Suratu Luqman da Suratul Hujurat
course.adab.short_description: Gajeren kwas mai darussa uku daga littafin «Al-Mukhtasar fi Tafsiril Kur'anil Karim»: bauta wa Allah da ikhlasi a Suratul Fatiha, hikima a Suratu Luqman, da ladabi ga Annabi ﷺ a Suratul Hujurat, tare da tambayoyin fahimta bayan kowane darasi.
course.adab.description: Wannan kwas yana bayani kan ladabi da kyawawan halayen Musulmi kamar yadda surori uku na Alkur'ani Mai Girma suka zana su, tare da tafsiri mai sauƙi daga littafin «Al-Mukhtasar fi Tafsiril Kur'anil Karim». Yana farawa da Suratul Fatiha, wadda ke koyar da tsarkake bauta ga Allah da neman taimako daga gare Shi kaɗai; sannan farkon Suratu Luqman da siffofin masu kyautatawa waɗanda ke amfana da hikima; sannan farkon Suratul Hujurat da ladabi ga Allah da Manzonsa ﷺ, ciki har da rage murya a gabansa. Kowane darasi yana da karatun shafin, tafsirin ayoyinsa da gajerun tambayoyin fahimta, kuma a ƙarshen kwas akwai jarrabawar ƙarshe.
course.adab.lesson.1.title: Suratul Fatiha
course.adab.lesson.1.subtitle: Bauta wa Allah da ikhlasi · Ayoyi 1–7
course.adab.lesson.1.q1.text: Me ya sa aka sanya wa Suratul Fatiha wannan suna?
course.adab.lesson.1.q1.a: Saboda da ita ne aka buɗe Littafin Allah
course.adab.lesson.1.q1.b: Saboda ita ce sura ta ƙarshe da aka saukar
course.adab.lesson.1.q1.c: Saboda ita ce sura mafi tsawo a Alkur'ani
course.adab.lesson.1.q2.text: Mene ne ma'anar «Yaumid Din» a cikin faɗinSa: {مَٰلِكِ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ}?
course.adab.lesson.1.q3.text: Mene ne madaidaiciyar hanya da muke roƙon Allah Ya shiryar da mu zuwa gare ta?
course.adab.lesson.1.q3.a: Musulunci, wato hanya bayyananniya wadda babu karkata a cikinta
course.adab.lesson.1.q3.c: Duk hanyar da yawancin mutane ke bi
course.adab.lesson.2.title: Suratu Luqman
course.adab.lesson.2.subtitle: Hikima da siffofin masu kyautatawa · Ayoyi 1–11
course.adab.lesson.2.q1.text: Wanne ne daga cikin manufofin Suratu Luqman?
course.adab.lesson.2.q1.a: Umurni da bin hikimar da ke cikin Alkur'ani, da gargaɗi game da bijire mata
course.adab.lesson.2.q2.text: A farkon Suratu Luqman, su wane ne Allah Ya sanya ayoyin Littafi shiriya da rahama a gare su?
course.adab.lesson.2.q3.text: Kamar yadda yake a aya ta bakwai, yaya mai girman kai yake idan aka karanta masa ayoyin Allah?
course.adab.lesson.2.q3.c: Yana juya musu baya kamar bai ji su ba
course.adab.lesson.3.title: Suratul Hujurat
course.adab.lesson.3.subtitle: Ladabi ga Annabi ﷺ · Ayoyi 1–4
course.adab.lesson.3.q1.text: Wanne ne daga cikin manufofin Suratul Hujurat?
course.adab.lesson.3.q1.a: Bayyana labaran annabawan da suka gabata
course.adab.lesson.3.q1.b: Gyara harshe da bayyana tasirinsa ga imanin mutum da halayen al'umma
course.adab.lesson.3.q2.text: Wane ladabi ne aya ta farko ta Suratul Hujurat ta yi umurni da shi?
course.adab.lesson.3.q2.a: Kada muminai su riga Allah da Manzonsa a magana ko aiki
course.adab.lesson.3.q2.c: Ɗaga murya a gaban Annabi ﷺ
course.adab.lesson.3.q3.text: Mene ne sakamakon waɗanda ke rage muryoyinsu a gaban Manzon Allah ﷺ?
course.adab.lesson.3.q3.c: Suna da gafara da lada mai girma
course.adab.quiz.title: Tambayoyin fahimta
course.adab.exam.title: Jarrabawar ƙarshe
course.adab.exam.q1.text: Mene ne ma'anar sunan «Allah» kamar yadda yake a tafsirin Basmala?
course.adab.exam.q1.a: Wanda ake bauta wa bisa gaskiya
course.adab.exam.q2.text: A cikin faɗinSa {إِيَّاكَ نَعۡبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسۡتَعِينُ}, daga wurin wa muke neman taimako?
course.adab.exam.q3.text: Da me Allah Ya siffanta masu kyautatawa a farkon Suratu Luqman?
course.adab.exam.q3.a: Suna mai da ayoyin Allah abin izgili
course.adab.exam.q3.b: Suna tsayar da sallah, suna ba da zakka, kuma suna da yaƙini da Lahira
course.adab.exam.q4.text: Daga me aya ta biyu ta Suratul Hujurat take gargaɗi?
course.adab.exam.q4.a: Daga ɗaga muryoyi sama da muryar Annabi ﷺ
course.adab.exam.q5.text: Zuwa me darussa uku na wannan kwas suke kira?
course.adab.exam.q5.b: Zuwa ladabi ga Allah da Manzonsa da kyawawan halaye

chat.course.title: Tattaunawar Kwas na Ladabi da Kyawawan Halaye
chat.course.m1: Assalamu alaikum wa rahmatullah, barkanku da zuwa tattaunawar kwas. Ku yi tambayoyinku game da darussan a nan.
chat.course.m2: Tunatarwa: ku fara da darasin Suratul Fatiha, sannan ku amsa tambayoyin fahimta da ke biye da shi domin darasi na gaba ya buɗe.
chat.support.title: Taimakon Fasaha
chat.support.m1: Barka da zuwa Moddaker, ta yaya za mu taimake ka?
